messages.subject: Tutorial phase: Error in if...
parts:
Dear Nick,

I am following your tutorial/example on Psychotria and I hit the wall three days ago. 
I searched for similiar posts in this group and I did not find anything. 

I am have a hard time to run DEC:

> check_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)
Read 6 items
Read 38 items
[1] TRUE
> runslow = TRUE
> resfn = "Psychotria_DEC_M0_unconstrained_v1.Rdata"
> if (runslow)
+ {
+   res = bears_optim_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)
+   res    
+   
+   save(res, file=resfn)
+   resDEC = res
+ } else {
+   # Loads to "res"
+   load(resfn)
+   resDEC = res
+ }
Read 6 items
Read 38 items
Read 6 items
Read 38 items

Your computer has 8 cores.
Error in if (num_cores_to_use > num_cores_computer_has) { : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed


There is no such file created in the wd.
OS: Windows.

Thank you in advance.

Peter

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Tutorial phase: Error in if...
parts:
Hi,

Some things to try:

1. Make sure library(snow) and/or library(parallel) work in your R terminal.

2. Make sure you're using this script, not another one:
http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeobears#script

3. ...in that script, run the lines in small chunks at first espeically make sure all the source() commands run

...cheers!
Ncik

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Tutorial phase: Error in if...
parts:
Hi!  Nowadays, there should be no source commands, all of the updates are on GitHub, so update to the GitHub version and try it again:
https://github.com/nmatzke/BioGeoBEARS

It may be that on Windows, you need just paralllel and not snow, or the reverse (try it each way, after updating BioGeoBEARS to GitHub version and re-starting R).

Cheers!
Nick
